environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.19. The mesh has PeerAuthentication set to STRICT for the data-layer namespace. An AuthorizationPolicy is applied to the data-layer namespace with a single rule: source principal must match 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/graphql-gateway-sa'. However, the gateway service account 'graphql-gateway-sa' has an additional CUSTOM action AuthorizationPolicy in the api-gateway namespace that delegates to an ext-authz provider ('envoy.ext_authz.graphql-validator') which performs query depth/complexity analysis and rejects queries containing unescaped quote characters in variable string values. The ext-authz filter runs as a separate sidecar container using a WASM plugin compiled from OPA policy that checks request body JSON paths matching '$.variables..value' for characters in the set ['"', '\\', '}', '{']. The WASM filter is loaded via EnvoyFilter resource targeting the gateway workload's inbound listener on port 8080.

wasm_plugin.policy: reject if any string value under $.variables contains characters: ["\"", "\\", "{", "}"]

config.network_policies: deny-all with explicit allow for api-gateway->data-layer on port 8081
